name: Live-bus synchronised closing gate
summary: Requires the defined synchronising conditions before connecting two live AC systems.
description: Requires the defined synchronising conditions before connecting two live AC systems. A closing circuit combines an operator or automatic request with the conditions that allow the breaker to close. The closing coil releases stored mechanism energy where that construction is used; it is different from the spring-charging motor.

In a switchgear bus-coupler panel, a close request is checked against position, mechanism readiness and the selected live-bus or dead-bus conditions before the closing circuit is enabled. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Two live-side measurements” at the input and “Synchronised close permission” at the output. Permissive limits require the approved connection study.

Follow request, permission and final coil output as separate signals. A permissive diagram must say which conditions block closing and what happens if a feedback signal becomes unavailable. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
